Consumer fixtures switched to real issued evidence; timeout declarations captured in W5 before test dispatch. No run attributed to W4.

36 matrix tests passed; own type diagnostics zero; 79 shared diagnostics remained.

171 tests passed, one sourcing explanation assertion failed after an asymmetric object matcher; source evidence assertion also had one own type diagnostic. Root cause inside the matcher is not asserted.
Only source-evidence assertion typing changed; own type diagnostics zero. No test snapshot dispatched while the W7 runtime failure was being repaired.
172 tests passed after independent scalar assertions; 79 shared type diagnostics remained.

172 tests passed; three current WP06 dossier HTTP cases failed at individual Request issuance because the integration projector diverged from the canonical approvalStage field set. Initial read/presentation assertions passed, later assertions were not reached.

Exact published WP10 canonical projection adapter composed. Main selection175/0, guards pass, own type diagnostics zero; package typecheck78 shared diagnostics and isolated WP06 runtime timeout remain unresolved.

artifactPolicy: Check artifacts have 14-day retention, with GitHub-reported SHA-256 digests recorded per run. Full job logs were read. Bun test-ci does not require a dedicated uploaded artifact; no absent mandatory artifact is treated as PASS.
checkSnapshotAncestry: Check snapshots have the exact product as first parent and, after the first check, the prior check snapshot as an additional parent, allowing fast-forward-only updates of astra-check-wp09. Their tree diff from product is only .astra-wp09-check.json; the workflow verifies that and checks out the exact product SHA.
